notes.note: Re-read terminal authority and retention after the API correction. Host facts are fixed at storage open and supplied through KernelTerminalFacts; KernelContext no longer offers a source override. Verified host observation/forgetting never maintain default facts, kernel mode retains its default terminal source, and the sequence/timestamp semantics and production integration deferral remain unchanged. This note covers the terminal-facts delta, not all package maturity or architecture claims.
